siebel.useCG: #Set to true to fetch the connect string from Cloud Gateway using 'cg-url'. If false, 'connect-string' will be used.
siebel.loginpath: #Base URL path for Siebel Open UI, used for Applet REST API requests (e.g., /siebel/app/<application>/<language>).

app.context: #Optional base path prefix for all APIs. Example: oracle → /oracle/openintegration/v1.0/... Set to null if not required.
app.metrics-path: #File system path where OpenIntegration transaction logs are stored.

eps.SecureAIEgressServer: # Mandatory. Set to true to enable TLS on AI egress server, false to disable.
eps.SecureAIToKafkaCommunication: # Mandatory. Set to true to enable secure communication between AI and Kafka, false otherwise.
eps.AIEgressPort: # Mandatory. EPS egress listener port. Example: 4002
eps.KafkaServers: # Mandatory. Kafka bootstrap servers in host:port format. Example: localhost:9092
eps.AIEgressServerKeyStoreName: # Conditionally mandatory when SecureAIEgressServer=true. Absolute path to AI egress server keystore file.
eps.AIEgressServerKeyStorePassword: # Conditionally mandatory when SecureAIEgressServer=true. Password for AI egress server keystore.
eps.TLSEnabledCipherSuites: # Optional. Comma-separated TLS cipher suites for the AI egress server. Defaults to TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384.
eps.KafkaKeyStoreName: # Conditionally mandatory when SecureAIToKafkaCommunication=true. Absolute path to Kafka client keystore file.
eps.KafkaKeyStorePassword: # Conditionally mandatory when SecureAIToKafkaCommunication=true. Password for Kafka client keystore.
eps.KafkaTrustStoreName: # Conditionally mandatory when SecureAIToKafkaCommunication=true. Absolute path to Kafka truststore file.
eps.KafkaTrustStorePassword: # Conditionally mandatory when SecureAIToKafkaCommunication=true. Password for Kafka truststore.
eps.KafkaPassword: # Conditionally mandatory when SecureAIToKafkaCommunication=true. Kafka key password.
eps.KafkaAuthenticationEnabled: # Optional. Set to true to enable SASL authentication for Kafka, false otherwise.
eps.KafkaAuthenticationMechanism: # Conditionally mandatory when KafkaAuthenticationEnabled=true. Supported examples: SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-512, PLAIN.
eps.KafkaAuthenticationUser: # Conditionally mandatory when KafkaAuthenticationEnabled=true. SASL username.
eps.KafkaAuthenticationPassword: # Conditionally mandatory when KafkaAuthenticationEnabled=true. SASL password.

BaseSiebelComponent.Alias: # Conditionally mandatory when BaseSiebelComponent is configured. Default Siebel OM alias for EPS event execution. Example: SCCObjMgr_enu
BaseSiebelComponent.SessionPoolSize: # Conditionally mandatory when BaseSiebelComponent is configured. Default Siebel session pool size. Example: 20
BaseSiebelComponent.User: # Conditionally mandatory when BaseSiebelComponent is configured. Default Siebel user for EPS event execution. Example: SADMIN
BaseSiebelComponent.Password: # Conditionally mandatory when BaseSiebelComponent is configured. Default Siebel password for EPS event execution.
BaseSiebelComponent.SessionTime: # Conditionally mandatory when BaseSiebelComponent is configured. Default Siebel session timeout. Example: 1000
BaseSiebelComponent.DefaultKafkaConsumerPollInterval: # Optional. Default Kafka consumer poll interval in milliseconds. Example: 100

ConfigParam.SynchronousKafkaProduce: # Mandatory. Set true for synchronous Kafka publish, false for asynchronous publish.
ConfigParam.KafkaDeliveryTimeout: # Optional. Kafka producer delivery.timeout.ms value in milliseconds. Default: 30000
ConfigParam.KafkaRequestTimeout: # Optional. Kafka producer request.timeout.ms value in milliseconds. Default: 10000
ConfigParam.NumberOfProducers: # Mandatory. Number of producer instances to initialize. Example: 1
ConfigParam.KafkaProducerPollInterval: # Optional. Async producer queue poll interval in milliseconds. Default: 1
ConfigParam.DefaultTopic: # Optional. Default Kafka topic used when the inbound payload does not specify a topic.
ConfigParam.KafkaProducerMaxRequestSize: # Optional. Kafka producer max.request.size in bytes. Default: 20971520
ConfigParam.KafkaPartitionConsumerFetchMaxBytes: # Optional. Kafka consumer max.partition.fetch.bytes in bytes. Preferred key. Default: 20971520
ConfigParam.KafkaTopicConsumerFetchMaxBytes: # Optional. Kafka consumer fetch.max.bytes in bytes. Preferred key. Default: 20971520

Events.EventStore: # Mandatory unless Topic is configured. Kafka topic/event store name to consume from. Example: OSM-Orders-Produce
Events.Topic: # Optional. Alternative to EventStore for backward compatibility. Use either EventStore or Topic.
Events.NumberOfConsumers: # Mandatory. Number of consumer instances for this topic. Example: 1
Events.KafkaConsumerPollInterval: # Optional. Consumer poll interval in milliseconds for this topic. Defaults to BaseSiebelComponent.DefaultKafkaConsumerPollInterval.
Events.Partitions: # Optional. Comma-separated Kafka partitions to assign for this topic. Example: 0,1,2
Events.KafkaConsumerGroupId: # Optional. Kafka consumer group id for this topic. Example: consumer-group-1

SiebelComponent.Alias: # Conditionally mandatory when SiebelComponent is configured. Siebel OM alias override for this topic. Example: SCCObjMgr_enu
SiebelComponent.SessionPoolSize: # Conditionally mandatory when SiebelComponent is configured. Siebel session pool size override for this topic. Example: 5
SiebelComponent.User: # Conditionally mandatory when SiebelComponent is configured. Siebel user override for this topic. Example: SADMIN
SiebelComponent.Password: # Conditionally mandatory when SiebelComponent is configured. Siebel password override for this topic.
SiebelComponent.SessionTime: # Conditionally mandatory when SiebelComponent is configured. Siebel session timeout override for this topic. Example: 1000

topic-name.default: # Optional. Relative path from config directory to the Avro schema for this topic. Example: schemas/topic-name.avsc
topic-name.0: # Optional. Relative path to the Avro schema for partition 0 when partition-specific schemas are required.

integration-domains: # Domains to be considered for integration flow , example : Telco

openintegration/v1.0/ui: #UI resource names (e.g., 'All Account List View/SIS Account Entry Applet', 'All Account List View/SIS Account Entry Applet/{id}/Contact Detail Applet').
openintegration/v1.0/service: #Business service operations Format: <Business Service Name>/<Method Name> (e.g., 'Siebel Account/Insert').
